# Free bowling arcade machine with SPECIAL bonus (Bethesda in-game package)

![](/uploads/ajaxGallery_238_nukaknights-post-bowling-arcade-machine.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

Secure your free in-game packages from Bethesda as part of the 5th anniversary of Fallout 76. In return, Bethesda would like you to subscribe to our newsletter. You can redeem the whole thing via your Bethesda account. There you should have connected your gaming accounts (Xbox, Steam, PS5) to receive the package.

Get a free bowling arcade machine

## Fallout 76: Bowling Arcade Machine Bonus

The bowling arcade machine is in your C.A.M.P. Construction menu available. If you play a round of this, you will receive +2 Luck** and **+2 Perception** for **30 minutes.

*Tip: Ideal and simple bonus for every sniper and commando build*

![Fallout 76 Bowling Arcade Machine](/uploads/fallout76-bowling-arcade-machine-2.jpg)

## Contents of the free in-game package

- **Fallout 76**
 Get the **Bowling Arcade Machine** to increase your luck and perception with a game of bowling.
- **Doom Eternal**
 Get the **Lux Slayer Special Edition Set**, which includes the Luxury Slayer Skin, Luxury Ballista Weapon Skin, Murder Magnate Nameplate, and Fancy Chick Icon.
- **Doom Eternal**
 Get the **Majestic Archvile Special Edition Set** , which includes the Majestic Archvile Skin, Your Majesty Nameplate, and the Prince Vile I Icon.
- **Doom Eternal**
 Get the **Nightmare Marauder Special Edition Set**, which includes the Nightmare Marauder Skin, Night Terror Nameplate, and Sleep Paralysis Demon Icon.
- **Wolfenstein Youngblood**
 Get the **Legacy Pack**, which includes the New Colossus Jacket and BJ's Army Power Armor Skins, the Old Blood Pipe and Piercing Weapons, and the WW2 Army Weapon Skin Set.
- **Rage 2**
 Get the **Golden Weapon Pack** with nine golden weapon skins, the **Doombringer Pack** with five DOOM-based weapon skins, and the **Apocalypse Weapon Pack** with four unique assault weapon skins.

![Free Fallout & Doom Eternal Bundle](/uploads/free-ingame-bundles-fallout-doom-de.jpg)

![Free Doom Eternal & Rage 2 Bundle](/uploads/free-ingame-bundles-doom-rage-de.jpg)

## This is how you get this package

1. Click on this button: Get a free bowling arcade machine
2. Now you are on Bethesda.net and log in with your account.
3. Now click the Redeem button and confirm your newsletter subscription. Complete.

![](/uploads/bethesda-free-ingame-bundle-redeem-de.jpg)
